name: After § 37
title: REPORT on the implementation of Europe’s Beating Cancer Plan
part_text: 37a. Calls on the Commission and the Member States to promote access to healthy, nutritious and balanced school meals, prioritising fresh, seasonal, locally sourced and minimally processed foods; underlines the importance of ensuring affordable access for all pupils and of integrating healthy school meals into long-term strategies to prevent childhood obesity and reduce cancer risk factors;
